vulnerability_patterns.description: A lookahead read uses `Data[a+1]` without first proving that `a+1` is still within the buffer length while iterating up to `a < length`.
trigger_conditions: Loop index `a` can reach `length-1` under `for (a=2; a<length; a++)`.
Current byte `ch = Data[a]` equals `\r`, causing evaluation of the lookahead condition.
The code reads `Data[a+1]` without a preceding bound proving `a < length-1`.
fix_patterns: Add an explicit guard `a < length-1` before accessing `Data[a+1]`.
Keep the dangerous sink local: guarded lookahead remains in the same conditional and is blocked on the final valid index.
evidence_lines: New barrier: `if (ch == '\r' && a < length-1 && Data[a+1] == '\n') continue;`

entry_points: Conditions that read `buf[index+1]`, `buf[index-1]`, or similar lookahead/lookbehind expressions inside loops
Array or pointer reads in boolean conjunctions where the bound check is absent or added by patch
Loops with upper bound `index < length` combined with sink `buffer[index+1]`
suggestions: 首稿直接命中 patch-local 锚点：循环内条件表达式中的 `Data[a+1]` 读取，而循环条件仅保证 `a < length`。
将 `a == length-1` 时发生的 lookahead 越界作为核心机制；不需要先依赖复杂污点传播。
新增的 `a < length-1` 是 barrier，但首稿不要把“存在该 guard”写成必要前提；应优先搜索缺少该 barrier 的同类 lookahead 访问。
辅助收敛条件可使用：同一基本块或同一条件中先有 `ch = Data[a]`，后有 `Data[a+1]`；以及循环上界是 `a < length`。
无需跨文件分析，只盯住补丁涉及函数/文件中的局部 AST/CFG 即可。
可泛化到 `index+const` 读取：若循环只证明 `index < len`，但读取 `buf[index+1]`，则要求额外证明 `index < len-1`。

added_guards: if (ch == '\r' && a < length-1 && Data[a+1] == '\n') continue; // Remove cr followed by lf.

analysis_rationale: The patch changes a single conditional inside the loop in `jpgfile.c` to add `a < length-1` before evaluating `Data[a+1]`. Before the fix, when the loop reaches `a == length-1` and `ch == '\r'`, the expression `Data[a+1]` reads one byte past the valid range. The fix is a patch-local barrier that prevents the lookahead access on the last iteration.
